'''Rigfu Urcolla'''<ref name="Minecraft">''[[Minecraft]]''</ref> was a [[Bufopel]] [[Gender|male]] patron of the [[Canto Casino and Racetrack|Canto Casino]] in the coastal [[city]] of [[Canto Bight]] on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Cantonica]] in the [[Standard year|year]] [[34 ABY]]. During a [[Mission to Canto Bight|mission]] undertaken by [[Resistance]] members [[Finn]], [[Rose Tico]], and [[BB-8]], he angrily slammed the table he was [[gambling]] at.<ref name="Episode VIII" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rigfu Urcolla first appeared in the [[2017]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']].<ref name="Episode VIII" /> The character was then first named in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Minecraft]]'' within a skin pack<ref name="Minecraft" /> in [[2018]].<ref name="MinecraftDate">{{SW|url=news/minecraft-artists-on-creating-53-new-character-designs-for-the-star-wars-sequel-skin-pack|text=''Minecraft'' Artists on Creating 53 New Character Designs for the ''Star Wars'' Sequel Skin Pack}}</ref>
